description: NaCaH₃ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent H atoms to form distorted NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent CaH₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent CaH₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one CaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are three shorter (2.29 Å) and three longer (2.44 Å) Na-H bond lengths. Ca is bonded to six equivalent H atoms to form CaH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CaH₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent NaH₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  a faceface with one NaH₆ pentagonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 44°. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.31 Å) Ca-H bond lengths. H is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ca atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing HNa₂Ca₂ trigonal pyramids.
